Owing to the late appearance of Eddie Kealey, our team in the 4 x 100 yards was not at full strength; and in the circumstances they did well to finish third in a very close finish, with Croydon beating Mitcham for first place.
Eddie Pack made a game effort but could never head his opponent; and Stroud's strength told in a close finish. E.
Grassau, Jones and Bill Sutton monopolised the crowd once they started, and apparently they had not met men of their magnificent physique before. Points were secured for us by E.
